entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="死体はどうしやす？" t="What do we do with the bodies?" b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="死体はどうしやす？" t="Ce facem cu cadavrele?" b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="溶かしてから海にでも流せ。一度に全部やるなよ" t="Dissolve them. Just make sure to spread it out along the docks." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="溶かしてから海にでも流せ。一度に全部やるなよ" t="Dizolvă-le și aruncă-le în mare. Da' nu tot deodată, pe la docuri." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="了解っす" t="Consider it done." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="jpn" o="了解っす" t="Am înțeles, e rezolvat." b="" a=""/>
